purpose: Teach: 増田/古田/川上/水野/古川/桜井/平田/西田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、顧問の増田先生のご助言を経営に活かせ
lines.en: We're going to put Masuda-sensei's advice from his role as advisor directly into our management strategy.
lines.style: Clear, authoritative opening. Clipped consonants on the key names. Measured pace, no hesitation. The voice of someone used to being heard the first time. Slight downward inflection—not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社外取締役の古田様のご見解を取り入れます
lines.en: Understood. We'll incorporate the perspective that Furuta brings as our outside director.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Crisp on 'Understood.' Steady, reliable tone—the voice of someone taking careful notes. Even pace, professional courtesy without flatness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、技術担当の川上部長を中心に新製品を進めろ
lines.en: Put Kawakani, our technical director, at the center of the new product initiative.
lines.style: Direct instruction. Slight emphasis on 'Kawakani'—naming the person responsible. Firm but not harsh. The weight of delegation in the delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報担当の水野様の戦略を採用します
lines.en: Yes. We'll adopt the strategy that Mizuno from our PR division has developed.
lines.style: Confirmation with intent. Warm undertone beneath the formality—showing he's tracking multiple people, multiple strengths. Slightly faster than before, as if moving down a checklist with confidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外戦略は古川取締役に一任しろ
lines.en: Our overseas strategy goes entirely to Furugawa. She has full authority.
lines.style: Decisive, almost clipped. Weight on 'entirely'—no ambiguity. The voice of someone making a clear cut, trusting the person named. Slight pause before the name, letting it land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新ブランドのデザインを桜井様に依頼します
lines.en: Understood. We'll ask Sakurai to handle the design for the new brand line.
lines.style: Registering the instruction. Lighter than the previous response—moving smoothly through the point. Professional, but a thread of recognition that this is good work for the right person.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新人研修は人事の平田主任に任せろ
lines.en: The onboarding program for new hires will be Hirata's responsibility. He's from HR.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delegation. Clear breath before naming the department. Calm authority—no doubt this is the right call. Straightforward delivery, slight trailing clarity on the final clause.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営理念の刷新は西田顧問のご助言で進めます
lines.en: Yes. We'll move forward with the management philosophy refresh under Nishida's advisory guidance.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slightly warmer, more settled—the note of conclusion. Steady, measured pace. The respect for Nishida comes through in the phrasing itself; voice mirrors that care with evenness and intent.
